findings.summary: _AttendancePill is a bespoke status-pill reimplementation that duplicates the shared MobileStatusPill widget (same rounded 12%-alpha container, 11px w900 label) instead of reusing it.
findings.fix: Extend the shared MobileStatusPill (add present/late/on_leave/absent/unregistered cases to its switch) and render MobileStatusPill(item.attendanceStatus ?? '') at line 124, deleting the local _AttendancePill class.

findings.summary: Attendance colors use raw Material palette (Colors.green/orange/blue/red/grey) rather than the app's curated shared status hex palette used by MobileStatusPill (e.g. 0xFF0F9F6E green, 0xFFD98508 amber, 0xFFDC3D4B red).
findings.fix: Replace Colors.green/orange/blue/red with the shared status palette constants (const Color(0xFF0F9F6E)/(0xFFD98508)/(0xFF008CB3)/(0xFFDC3D4B)) and use scheme.onSurfaceVariant for the unregistered/grey case, matching MobileStatusPill.

findings.summary: Error state is bare centered text with no icon, muted color, or retry affordance, inconsistent with the app's polished empty/error patterns.
findings.fix: Add a muted error layout (e.g. Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: colorScheme.error) + message styled with onSurfaceVariant + a TextButton 'إعادة المحاولة' calling ref.invalidate(mobileTeamProvider)).

findings.summary: _metric uses hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize: 18/11) with no theme text style or colorScheme, so the label lacks the standard muted onSurfaceVariant treatment used elsewhere (e.g. MetricCard).
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium (value) and labelMedium.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant) (label) instead of hardcoded fontSize styles.

findings.summary: Empty-state icon uses size 54 while every sibling page (kpi/requests: 48, executive_people: 42) uses a smaller size, making this page's empty icon an outlier.
findings.fix: Change size: 54 to size: 48 to match the mobile_kpi_page / mobile_requests_page empty-state convention.

findings.summary: Empty-state icon has no color so it renders at full onSurface opacity instead of the muted tone appropriate for a placeholder.
findings.fix: Add color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant to the search_off_rounded Icon.

findings.summary: CircleAvatar initial uses item.name.substring(0,1) which throws on an empty name and gives no accessible label/tooltip for the avatar.
findings.fix: Guard the substring (item.name.isEmpty ? '?' : item.name.characters.first) and wrap the leading avatar in a Semantics label of item.name.
